coreIdea: FIFO. Minimum 2 stacks to implement a queue. Circular array wraps via mod. Linked-list queue needs BOTH head and tail pointers for O(1) both ways.
mustRememberFormulas: Queue via 2 stacks: pour S1→S2 only when S2 is empty (amortized O(1))
front==rear is ambiguous (full vs empty) — needs count/flag/wasted-slot

patternRecognitionTable.seeThis: FIFO/LIFO TRUE-FALSE statement, or design-a-DS question
sequence of enqueue/dequeue/deque-ops, asked for result

commonTrapsQuickList: FIFO = Queue, NOT Stack — don't mislabel
Pour S1→S2 only when S2 is empty (not every dequeue)
1 stack alone can't implement a queue — need 2
Single-pointer linked list queue is O(n) for one op UNLESS it's circular-with-rear-pointer (then both O(1))
highYieldPyqLessons: Queue-via-stack design (5/15) is the dominant skill — the S1/S2 'pour only when empty' rule is the single most important fact.
Recent years (2022+) combine stack AND queue in the same question — practice tracking two structures simultaneously.
